name: Mahalakshmi
benefit: Free eligible bus travel / ₹500 LPG; cash component requires confirmation
desc: The guarantee groups cash support, subsidised LPG and bus travel. Each component has its own eligibility and implementation status.

Ask the relevant department to confirm eligibility and present availability.
For bus travel, confirm the covered service and accepted identity proof before boarding.
docs: Confirm the current scheme-specific documents at the responsible office.

name: Gruha Jyothi
benefit: Zero bill for eligible monthly consumption up to 200 units
desc: Eligible households can receive a zero electricity bill when consumption is at or below the scheme threshold.
contact: Electricity section office / DISCOM customer-service centre
amountNote: The official order requires a valid Food Security Card, Aadhaar linkage and a domestic service number through an approved application channel. Consumption above 200 units is not simply a free first-200-unit allowance.
steps: Read the latest order and check the domestic connection details.
Ask the electricity section office to verify the scheme linkage.
Raise incorrect billing through the DISCOM’s official grievance route.
docs: Confirm the current scheme-specific documents at the responsible office.

desc: The official state initiatives page confirms health coverage under Rajiv Aarogyasri. Pension amounts and category eligibility require their own current orders.
